title: My Beeloved: A Bee Dating Sim
description:
In My Beeloved, you play as a struggling café barista who enters a chaotic, emotional, and explicit relationship with a bee. This is a fully voiced visual novel dating sim.

Earn Buzzies by making decisions that satisfy Beemo. These points determine your ending and unlock replayable steamy memories in the menu.

Streamer Mode lets creators safely share the absurd comedy without showing the most explicit content.

💛 Darkly humorous storyline with an unexpected lover🖤 Raunchy mature content, including nudity and animated scenes💛 Use Buzzies to unlock steamy replayable memories and decide your fate🖤 Minigames💛 Fully voiced characters🖤 Two main endings💛 Steam Achievements🖤 Around 2 hours of fully voiced visual novel gameplay 

Depictions of consensual sexual acts, BDSM, nudity, drug usage, strong language, blood, and violence. However, a safe and streamer-friendly mode is available.
description_short: A fully voiced raunchy bee dating sim. Make choices, earn Buzzies, play minigames, laugh, cry, and unlock endings.
